id: 03_Protect Your Team with Lab Equipment Safety and Maintenance Training
title: 仪器设备的安全与维护（国内版）
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/03_Protect Your Team with Lab Equipment Safety and Maintenance Training.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/03_Protect Your Team with Lab Equipment Safety and Maintenance Training（国内版）/src.py

points.K2: 重视校准，更要重视安全
points.K4: 定期维护，专业人员检修
points.K7: 通风柜失灵：确保安全后停工
points.S1: 故障设备：断电、挂牌、不私修
points.S4: 特种设备：定期检验、持证操作

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台大型分析仪旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a large benchtop analyzer with a blank screen and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲仪器设备的安全与维护。
overlay: 仪器设备的安全与维护

shots.scene: 说明书、扳手、放大镜、暂停手势四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a blank manual, a wrench, a magnifying glass and a raised stop hand. No people.
shots.narration: 读说明、勤维护、常检查、有异常就停。

shots.scene: 阿杰在仪器前皱眉闻了闻，仪器后面冒出一缕细烟
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sniffs the air with a frown beside an instrument; a thin wisp of grey smoke rises from behind it.
shots.narration: 阿杰闻到仪器后面有点焦味。

shots.scene: 阿杰耸耸肩，继续按按钮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shrugs and keeps pressing buttons on the instrument panel.
shots.narration: 他想：先把这批样品测完再说。

shots.scene: 小研快步过来，抬手示意停下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hurries over and raises her hand in a stop gesture.
shots.narration: 小研喊停：有焦味，马上停机报告！

shots.scene: 仪器端正放在稳固台面上，四周留有空隙
shots.prompt_en: An instrument sits squarely on a sturdy bench with clear space around it for ventilation. No people.
shots.narration: 设备要放得稳，周围留出散热空间。

shots.scene: 小研用布擦净仪器表面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the surface of an instrument clean with a cloth.
shots.narration: 保持清洁，维护到位，安全才有底。

shots.section_title: 重视校准，更要重视安全
shots.scene: 校准砝码和天平打勾的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a balance with a calibration weight and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 大家都知道，校准关系数据准不准。
overlay: 重视校准，更要重视安全

shots.section_title: 重视校准，更要重视安全
shots.scene: 欣欣指着自己的护目镜，眉头一挑
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at its safety goggles and raises an eyebrow.
shots.narration: 那安全这件事，你同样细心吗？

shots.scene: 小研翻开一本空白说明书，站在新仪器旁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank instrument manual beside a new instrument still in its packaging.
shots.narration: 用新设备前，先读厂家说明书。

shots.scene: 说明书页面上警示三角和参数表图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank manual page showing a yellow warning triangle icon and an empty specification table. No people.
shots.narration: 看清适用范围、限制条件和警示。

shots.section_title: 定期维护，专业人员检修
shots.scene: 老李打开仪器侧板做保养
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens a side panel of an instrument for routine servicing with a toolbox beside him.
shots.narration: 设备要定期维护，
overlay: 定期维护，专业人员检修

shots.section_title: 定期维护，专业人员检修
shots.scene: 阿杰拿起螺丝刀想自己修，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches for a screwdriver to open an instrument himself; the scene is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 检修交给有资质的专业人员。

shots.scene: 仪器门上的密封圈出现裂口的示意图
shots.prompt_en: Close icon of an instrument door seal ring with a visible crack, a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 看到密封圈、垫片损坏，

shots.scene: 停止手势和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A raised stop hand icon followed by an arrow to a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 立即停止工作，马上报告。

shots.scene: 仪器背后冒出细烟，鼻子图标
shots.prompt_en: A thin wisp of smoke rises behind an instrument, with a nose icon and a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 闻到焦糊味，同样立即停工报告。

shots.scene: 小研关掉仪器开关
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off the instrument at its power switch.
shots.narration: 能安全关机就先关机，别硬撑着做完。

shots.section_title: 通风柜失灵：确保安全后停工
shots.scene: 通风柜上的风量报警灯亮红色
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood with its airflow alarm light glowing red and its sash half open. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜不排风了，报警灯亮了，
overlay: 通风柜失灵：确保安全后停工

shots.section_title: 通风柜失灵：确保安全后停工
shots.scene: 小研盖好容器，把通风柜视窗拉下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves caps a bottle inside the fume hood and lowers the sash.
shots.narration: 先盖好容器、拉下视窗，再停工。

shots.section_title: 通风柜失灵：确保安全后停工
shots.scene: 小研离开通风柜去打电话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student steps away from the fume hood and makes a phone call.
shots.narration: 离开到安全处，立即报告。

shots.scene: 大型分析仪和电线插头，闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: A large analyzer with its power cord and plug, a yellow electrical warning sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 大型分析仪这些设备，都有触电风险。

shots.scene: 液体渗漏、冷凝水滴、电线破皮三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a liquid leak under an instrument, water condensation drops on a pipe, and a power cord with frayed insulation. No people.
shots.narration: 漏液、冷凝水、电线破皮，都是隐患。

shots.scene: 小研拿着空白检查表巡查仪器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks past a row of instruments holding a blank checklist and a pen.
shots.narration: 所有设备，都要定期、彻底地检查。

shots.scene: 检查表上一项项打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist getting green check marks one by one beside icons of a cord, a seal and a fan. No people.
shots.narration: 形成习惯，按清单一项项过。

shots.section_title: 故障设备：断电、挂牌、不私修
shots.scene: 老李拔下故障仪器的插头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unplugs a faulty instrument from the wall socket.
shots.narration: 设备出故障，先断电。
overlay: 故障设备：断电、挂牌、不私修

shots.section_title: 故障设备：断电、挂牌、不私修
shots.scene: 仪器上挂着一张空白的停用牌
shots.prompt_en: A blank red tag hangs on the front of the instrument with a stop hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 挂上停用标识，提醒别人不要再用。

shots.section_title: 故障设备：断电、挂牌、不私修
shots.scene: 小研向老周报告，老周点头记下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man, who nods and writes in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人，等修好验收再用。

shots.scene: 插线板串插线板，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A power strip plugged into another power strip, crossed out with a big red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不私拉电线，不串接插线板。

shots.scene: 大功率设备接在墙上专用插座
shots.prompt_en: A high-power drying oven plugged directly into a dedicated wall socket with a breaker box nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 大功率设备，用专用插座。

shots.scene: 湿手伸向开关，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A wet hand reaching for an electrical switch, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 湿手不碰电器，设备外壳要接地。

shots.scene: 阿杰在仪器旁的空白登记本上签字
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank usage logbook placed beside an instrument.
shots.narration: 大型仪器经培训授权，用前登记。

shots.scene: 夜晚的实验室里仪器还在运行，旁边空无一人，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An instrument running in an empty dark lab at night with no one around, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 运行中别走开，过夜运行要经批准。

shots.section_title: 特种设备：定期检验、持证操作
shots.scene: 高压灭菌器和气瓶，上面贴着空白检验合格标签
shots.prompt_en: An autoclave and a gas cylinder secured with a chain, each with a blank green inspection tag. No people.
shots.narration: 高压灭菌器、气瓶等是特种设备，
overlay: 特种设备：定期检验、持证操作

shots.section_title: 特种设备：定期检验、持证操作
shots.scene: 王老师查看空白检验证书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank inspection certificate posted beside an autoclave.
shots.narration: 要定期检验，按规定持证操作。

shots.scene: 精密仪器旁的金币图标和小齿轮图标
shots.prompt_en: A delicate instrument with a coin stack icon and a small gear icon floating beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 仪器昂贵精密，也容易出故障。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰在运转正常的仪器旁并肩工作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student work side by side, wearing goggles, at a smoothly running instrument.
shots.narration: 更要紧的是自己和同事的健康。

shots.scene: 欣欣轻拍仪器，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats a clean instrument and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 爱护设备，设备也会保护你。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现说明书和扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a blank manual and a wrench.
shots.narration: 先读说明书，专业人员定期维护。

shots.scene: 密封圈、鼻子、通风柜三个图标和停止手势
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a cracked seal, a nose and a fume hood, next to a raised stop hand. No people.
shots.narration: 密封坏、有焦味、通风停，立即停工报告。

shots.scene: 插头、停用牌、登记本三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a power plug, a blank red tag and a blank logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 规范用电，故障挂牌，用前登记。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的仪器旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a clean, tidy instrument.
shots.narration: 照顾好设备，也照顾好自己，下次见！
